```{.song}
[C] Row, row, row your boat, gently down the stream
[F] merrily, merrily, [C] merrily, merrily [G] life is but a [C] dream.

[C] Row, row, row your boat, gently up the creek
[F] If you see a [C] little mouse [G] don't forget to [C] squeek.

[C] Row, row, row your boat, gently down the stream
[F] If you see a [C] crocodile[G] don't forget to [C] scream.

[C] Row, row, row your boat, gently to the shore
[F] If you see a, [C] lion there [G] don't forget to [C] roar.
```
